LanguageData.LP_FiendCore.label: body of the Nine Hells
LanguageData.LP_FiendCore.description: The body of devils and demons: no eating or sleeping, and no care about nakedness. When knocked down or killed they are banished to the Nine Hells, leaving no survivor and no corpse, only loot on the spot. Cold iron weapons deal ×1.5 damage to them.
LanguageData.LP_FiendCore.customEffectDescriptions.0: Downed or killed: turns into black smoke and is banished to the Nine Hells, dropping weapons and loot; can't be captured or recruited.
LanguageData.LP_IceDevilStature.label: ice devil build
LanguageData.LP_IceDevilStature.description: An ice devil's tall carapaced body: actual body size ×150%, drawn ×130%, a pair of ice-blue curved horns. Giant-body rules give it health ×125% and melee ×115%.
LanguageData.LP_IceDevilCold.label: frost body
LanguageData.LP_IceDevilCold.description: Ice devils don't fear cold and can't be ignited; fire damage halved. Biting chill surrounds them within 5 cells: hostile characters gain one stack of "chilled to the bone" per second (up to 3 stacks, each move speed ×85% and melee cooldown ×110%), fading 30 seconds after leaving.
LanguageData.LP_IceDevilStinger.label: ice-spiked tail
LanguageData.LP_IceDevilStinger.description: An ice devil's ice-spiked tail. Gains the "tail spike" melee attack: sharp (stab) 18 damage, cooldown 3 seconds, each hit adds a stack of chilled to the bone.
LanguageData.LP_IceDevilSight.label: devil's eye
LanguageData.LP_IceDevilSight.description: An ice devil's compound eyes see through every illusion: a great wyrm's invisibility, a mind flayer's psionic concealment and invisibility potions are all visible to it as usual and can be targeted normally.
LanguageData.LP_IceDevilSight.customEffectDescription: Ignores the target's psychic invisibility when seeking and attacking targets.
LanguageData.LP_SkinIceDevil.label: ice-blue carapace
LanguageData.LP_SkinIceDevil.description: An ice devil's ice-blue carapace covered in white frost.
LanguageData.LP_BalorStature.label: balor build
LanguageData.LP_BalorStature.description: The balor's huge body: actual body size ×250%, drawn ×160%, a pair of huge charred red-tinged horns. Giant-body rules give it health ×175% and melee ×145%.
LanguageData.LP_BalorFlame.label: abyssal flames
LanguageData.LP_BalorFlame.description: A balor is wrapped in abyssal fire: completely immune to fire damage and can't be ignited, but fears cold (cold damage ×150%). Every 2 seconds, each flammable thing and character within 2 cells of it has a 20% chance to catch fire, friend or foe.
LanguageData.LP_BalorWings.label: balor wings
LanguageData.LP_BalorWings.description: A pair of huge charred red-tinged bat wings. Ability "Wing buffet": throw enemies within 4 cells back 2 cells and stun them for 2 seconds, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_BalorDeathburst.label: death throes
LanguageData.LP_BalorDeathburst.description: When a balor is struck down its body starts to crumble and explodes after 1 second: 40 fire damage within radius 4, igniting the ground, hitting friend and foe alike.
LanguageData.LP_BalorDeathburst.customEffectDescripti: On dissipating: after 1 second, a fire explosion of radius 4 (40 damage).
LanguageData.LP_SkinBalor.label: abyssal dark red
LanguageData.LP_SkinBalor.description: A balor's dark red skin with firelight glowing through the cracks.
